items.new_text: Given a project that requires every outside reviewer to answer, when fewer reviewers answered than were set up, then the review step reports that it did not succeed, names the reviewers that are missing and ends with an error; a project that has not asked for this still proceeds on a single reviewer's opinion. Either way, the number of reviewers that were set up is reported next to the number that answered, and the recorded review state marks a one-reviewer pass as partial instead of plain completed.
